description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wariyapola, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.  420946
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property characteristics) in Wariyapola, Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
